findings.detail: Event(s) evt_failed_01 x2 delivered more than once; counted once.
2 retries proposed for one failed transfer (1 unique failure event). That pays the supplier 2 times.
Retry uses request_id 92a1f546-3b61-991c-ce36-09a72f35bbd3, not the intent's stable id.
Last arrival says PROCESSING, created_at order says CANCELLED. Using created_at and GET /api/v1/transfers/{id}.
The original failed on the payee name or account (INVALID_ACCOUNT_NAME_OR_NUMBER). This retry goes to beneficiary 9a45987e-cffc-4f0a-81d7-[digits] unchanged. It would fail the same way.
USD would end at -65000 after queued payouts, below the 10000 reserve.

USD available is only 22000, but each retry is 40000 USD. A single retry cannot be funded, and the plan schedules no fx_conversion to tap the 60000 EUR balance. The executor funds before retry_transfer, so the transfer errors on insufficient funds and the run stops at the first error — nothing goes out. This is separate from the reserve floor: even one corrected $40000 transfer is unfundable from current USD (22000 - 40000 = -18000).

The actions list has only two retry_transfer moves and no correct_beneficiary move, so the confirmed correction (accountName/companyName 'Northwind Steel Fabrication LLC', same accountLast4 4417, callback-verified) is never written to beneficiary 9a45987e. To let the transfer pass INVALID_ACCOUNT_NAME_OR_NUMBER, schedule a correct_beneficiary move calling POST /api/v1/beneficiaries/{id}/update with exactly those names before the retry (executor order: correct_beneficiary then retry_transfer).

Execute quoted FX first to cover shortfall and preserve reserve; defer marketing payout until supplier settles so it cannot breach the floor.

findings.detail: Event(s) evt_failed_01 x2 delivered more than once; counted once.
Last arrival says PROCESSING, created_at order says CANCELLED. Using created_at and GET /api/v1/transfers/{id}.

The FX leg gets 28,000 USD, which brings USD to 50,000. That leaves exactly the 10,000 reserve after the 40,000 retry. But the quote expires at 14:15, which is 15 minutes after now (14:00). The executor runs only after a human approves, and 40,000 is over the 10,000 approval threshold. If approval and execution come after 14:15, the FX leg fails. The run then stops before the retry, and the invoice stays unpaid. Fix the amount after a re-quote.

The retry keeps the reference 'INV-2291 Northwind Steel'. That name no longer matches the corrected payee, 'Northwind Steel Fabrication LLC'. It probably will not change the bank's name check, but it makes reconciliation harder and could raise a question at approval. Consider 'INV-2291 Northwind Steel Fabrication LLC'.
